zh: 看板快照读不出来：插件路由改到 `/api/widget-board`，浏览器半边改用文档相对地址。桌面外壳的页面来源是自定义协议，只有 `/api/*` 会被转给宿主。
en: The board snapshot failed to load: the plugin's routes moved under `/api/widget-board` and the browser half now uses document-relative addresses. The desktop shell serves the page from a custom protocol and only forwards `/api/*` to the host.
